title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Wednesday, 4 November 2026
description: Apple opens its Siri AI developer preview to all app makers, the High Court orders Uber to pay $81 million in payroll tax, a Queensland court quashes a mining decision over a Cape York consultation failure, and the Gold Coast Suns prepare to host Hawthorn in an AFLW elimination final. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
